pr_title: Fix song select background not showing in multiplayer/playlists
pr_body:
The screen was now being loaded against incorrect dependencies. I'm not sure why I thought it wasn't possible to just do the `Push` in `LoadComplete` as it seems to work without issue this time...

Closes #13974.
pr_comments: Latest test failure looks likely to be related (possibly due to the schedule?). Pretty spooky that it's not failing *more*, because I can repro a failure pretty reliably locally, regardless of threading mode even...

issue_context.title: Beatmap background not showing in playlist/mulitplayer song select
issue_context.body:
**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
![osu_2021-07-21_21-31-22](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/126590148-f3dd17a5-53c1-465e-a7ac-aff2b7188cff.jpg)


**osu!lazer version:** Since https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/13946
comments: I'm guessing this has to do with the change of where the component is loaded (against the current screen rather than the screen stack, see https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/13946/files#diff-26417f10ac2c232c62e2413df2f3639f6d1448de497988eadab3237d4411342fR168).

review_comments:
Pretty sure this delayed push is causing the test failures. Long and short of it is that it prevents guards on `multiplayerScreen.IsLoaded` on screens from working properly, since the root screen may be loaded, but its subscreen (which may handle input, etc.) is not necessarily so at that point.

Unsure whether the way forward is to fix the test or change something here - I understand that this move to `LoadComplete()` is integral to making this pull work?
I'm not too sure yet, going to need some further investigation. I think maybe a change to the `ScreenStack` API may be required to make this work well.
Seems like adding a load-wait step is ample here. All the other flows which rely on the lounge to be loaded are guarded with `Schedule` calls in this PR.
